02 / THE PROBLEM & USE CASE

“Disk full” is a late warning.

A shared engineering lab accumulates datasets, project archives and duplicate submissions. The administrator needs visibility before disruption.

  • Actor: laboratory administrator
  • Trigger: capacity review before project submissions
  • Outcome: inventory, duplicate findings and a capacity scenario
03 / HOW IT WORKS

Scan. Understand. Plan.

  1. Python inventories a selected folder without modifying files.
  2. Equal-size candidates are verified using streaming SHA-256.
  3. A local JSON inventory feeds the browser dashboard.
  4. The administrator adjusts growth and previews duplicate savings.

No trained ML model. No automatic deletion.

04 / LIVE DEMONSTRATION

Turn a number into a decision.

742 GB / 1,000 GB used. At 6 GB/day: 43 days of runway.
275 GB in extra copies. Cleanup scenario: 89 days of runway.
Increase growth to 12 GB/day: initial runway falls to 22 days.

Open the interactive dashboard ↗

These values belong to the explicitly labelled synthetic demonstration dataset.
05 / EVIDENCE & BOUNDARIES

Real files. Explainable results.

Demonstrate two identical files and one different file of the same length. Import the scan and inspect the single extra copy.

  • 2 Python tests and 6 JavaScript assertions passed.
  • Runway = ceiling of remaining capacity / selected daily growth.
  • Folder composition differs from volume-wide usage.
  • Next: historical samples, incremental scans and audit logging.
